hero.subtitle: Appointment agents, protected patient records, analytics and dependable infrastructure for hospitals, clinics and health clusters.

context.title: The sector today
context.body: Healthcare in the Kingdom is being reorganized around health clusters, digital services and prevention. Providers need to serve more patients with the same staff while protecting highly sensitive data.

challenges.title: Appointment and call volumes
challenges.body: Booking lines are busy and no-shows waste clinic time.

challenges.title: Sensitive patient data
challenges.body: Clinical records must be protected on screen, in print and in transit.

challenges.title: Always-on infrastructure
challenges.body: Clinical systems and networks cannot afford downtime.

useCases.title: Appointment agents
useCases.body: Book, confirm, reschedule and remind patients by voice and WhatsApp.

useCases.title: Patient-record protection
useCases.body: Watermarks and screen control on clinical applications.

useCases.title: Capacity forecasting
useCases.body: Predict demand for beds, clinics and staff.

useCases.title: Hospital network modernization
useCases.body: Upgrade networks and low-current systems without disrupting care.

vision2030.body: Digital, accessible and efficient healthcare is a core goal of the health sector transformation.
